scope: Declared isolated fixtures at 120 Hz. Intact city and real keyboard/camera driving acceptance are not inferred. Initial rolling velocity/wheel spin are fixture setup only; all subsequent movement is integrated.

trace.format: gzip of UTF-8 NDJSON, one full sample per 120 Hz physical step
